title: Autodesk POLYFACE ordering and explicit-mesh contract
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research, local source audit, and focused fast validation
scope: Cross-check explicit-facet DXF schemas against Autodesk references and a maintained open-source DXF data model
Resolve the read-versus-write ordering contract for POLYFACE and map it to current local code and tests
Refine existing PAR-06/PAR-07/S5/S8 family-specific evidence criteria without changing support claims or validation cadence

sources.observation: The POLYLINE table defines subtype flags and per-family fields, including polygon-mesh counts, smooth-surface parameters, WCS/OCS distinctions, and obsolete group-66 handling.

Header groups 71/72 may be incorrect; applications should generate coordinate VERTEX records before face records; readers should tolerate odd vertex/face ordering; face records are limited to four vertex references by AutoCAD's entity structure.
3DFACE is a WCS corner entity; a triangle may repeat its third corner as the fourth, and group 70 contains four independent invisible-edge flags.

MESH has distinct counted vertex/face/edge/crease/override fields and supports n-gons; ezdxf's public model uses zero-based indices into its vertex array. The ezdxf 1.4.5 entity page says R2000 minimum, while older internal documentation has an inconsistent introduction-era statement, so this source set does not resolve historical target-version acceptance.
Readers must not assume the displayed group-code order. Entity group-0 boundaries and entity-specific child/count semantics remain meaningful.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw source and generated fast test
sources.observation: The reader validates signed indices against the completed actual coordinate pool before callback publication, tolerates advisory counts and noncanonical/forward face order, and permits one-/two-index wireframe records. The writer validates and emits stable coordinate and face pools without mutating caller vector order. The generated ASCII/Binary test also checks invalid-index transactional refusal and a following entity.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-06: map hostile polyface indices to the existing completed-pool guard and fast test
PAR-07/S5: keep 3DFACE, classic POLYLINE/PFACE and MESH wire/topology contracts separate
S8: score explicit-geometry consumers per family and exact version, not as a generic mesh result
assessment.planImpact: Add an authoritative POLYFACE read/write ordering note and record the verified local guard; retain distinct 3DFACE, PFACE, and MESH evidence lanes; keep pre-AC1024 MESH output unqualified pending authoritative/version-specific evidence.

method.limitations: The Autodesk POLYFACE ordering reference is historical (2016); current references were also checked for POLYLINE, MESH, and 3DFACE. MESH historical minimum/version naming remains unresolved. The local generated regression establishes parser/writer behavior only, not independent CAD acceptance, manifoldness, solid validity, or general 3D semantic support.
